name: New Birth
overview: The New Birth is a spiritual transformation essential for entering the kingdom of God, as Jesus explains to Nicodemus that one must be born again to see God's kingdom (John 3:3). This new life involves repentance and baptism in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, accompanied by receiving the Holy Spirit (Acts 2:38). The authority of Christ to forgive sins and bring about this new birth is demonstrated in His healing power (Matthew 9:6), and believers are commissioned to share this gospel message with all people (Mark 16:15). Baptism, as practiced by Jesus and His disciples, symbolizes this profound spiritual renewal (John 3:22).
